dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical, gradual narrowing from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins appear smooth and convex with no visible localized structural bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white; median pixel intensity is consistent with a near-mature individual.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey patches are visible across the mid-dorsal and anterior regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light grey canvas and the darker mottled areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, fine linear markings on the mid-dorsal region and high-contrast transverse light marks on the posterior peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of transverse, light-colored scars or skin folds are clearly visible on the dorsal surface of the peduncle.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, high-contrast dark circular blowhole aperture located on the midline.
